security_audit.summary: All 35 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown links, code fences, inline labels, ordinary marketing terms, and GitHub metadata. The skill does direct the agent to persist campaign details in memory files and a shared hot cache, creating a separate confidentiality risk for sensitive launch plans.

remediation.issue: Campaign details are saved and promoted to persistent memory without an explicit confirmation step.
remediation.suggestion: Make persistence opt-in, show the destination paths, and exclude confidential budgets, launch dates, and strategy details from shared memory by default.

semantic_findings.title: Persistent Storage of Sensitive Campaign Details
semantic_findings.description: The skill saves campaign plans and promotes budgets, launch dates, objectives, and KPI targets to persistent memory. Confidential strategy may remain available beyond the request without explicit user approval.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill contract explicitly requires a saved plan and promotion of durable campaign facts to a hot cache. The security impact depends on host isolation and the sensitivity of user inputs.

content.value_statement: Influencer campaigns often lack aligned objectives, budgets, timelines, and measurement plans. This skill turns campaign inputs into a structured strategy and execution blueprint.
actual_capabilities: Converts brand, audience, budget, timeline, and constraints into a structured campaign brief.
Defines SMART objectives with measurable targets and explicit success and failure criteria.
Recommends creator tiers, partner models, platform roles, deliverables, and selection criteria.
Builds a four-phase timeline covering selection, production, activation, and reporting.
Allocates budgets and defines KPI targets, attribution methods, reporting cadence, and risk controls.
limitations: It relies on user inputs unless optional data connectors are available.
It does not discover, contact, or verify individual creators.
Benchmarks and forecasts depend on supplied historical data and market context.
It does not create creator briefs, negotiate contracts, publish content, or run campaigns.

use_cases.title: Plan a Product Launch
use_cases.description: Create the creator channel plan for a launch with tier allocation, deliverables, budget, milestones, and conversion tracking.

use_cases.title: Design a Seasonal Activation
use_cases.description: Build a multi-platform campaign around a seasonal event with clear content themes, approval dates, and performance targets.

use_cases.title: Restructure an Underperforming Program
use_cases.description: Use past results to revise the creator mix, platform allocation, cost targets, reporting cadence, and failure thresholds.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an influencer campaign for [product] targeting [audience] on [platform]. Use a budget of [amount] from [start date] to [end date].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the main campaign inputs are already known.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Seasonal Activation
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a seasonal creator campaign for [brand] around [event]. Define objectives, platform roles, creator tiers, deliverables, timeline, budget, and KPIs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a scheduled event across one or more platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Campaign Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign this underperforming campaign using these results: [results]. Preserve [constraints] and improve [priority metrics] within a budget of [amount].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when historical performance data should guide a revised plan.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Approval-Ready Blueprint
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete nine-section campaign plan for [brand]. Include assumptions, benchmarks, budget efficiency, attribution, approvals, failure criteria, risks, and handoff actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a detailed plan that stakeholders can review before execution.

output_examples.input: Launch a sustainable sneaker for Gen Z on TikTok and Instagram with a $50,000 budget.
output: Primary objective: Reach qualified Gen Z audiences and measure launch sales through creator codes and tagged links.
Creator mix: Prioritize micro and nano creators, supported by selected mid-tier partners for launch reach.
Execution: Use product demonstrations, transparent sustainability claims, phased approvals, and weekly performance reporting.

output_examples.input: Improve an always-on beauty campaign with high reach but weak sales conversion.
output: Strategy change: Shift budget toward creators with strong product education and verified audience fit.
Measurement change: Add creator-specific codes, tagged links, conversion thresholds, and weekly budget reallocation rules.
Risk control: Review claims, disclosure, landing-page alignment, creator conflicts, and attribution gaps before scaling.

best_practices: Provide the audience, budget, dates, campaign objective, platforms, and approval constraints before planning.
Supply past campaign results and internal benchmarks when setting targets or forecasting efficiency.
Review assumptions, creator exclusions, legal disclosures, and memory destinations before approving the plan.
anti_patterns: Do not request a complete plan without a budget, timeframe, audience, or measurable objective.
Do not treat follower count as sufficient evidence of creator quality or audience fit.
Do not use projected results as guarantees or leave approval, disclosure, and attribution responsibilities undefined.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the brand, product, audience, objective, budget, platforms, dates, constraints, and approval requirements.

faq.question: Can it choose specific influencers?
faq.answer: It defines selection criteria and creator tiers, but a separate discovery process must identify and verify individual creators.

faq.question: Does it require live data integrations?
faq.answer: No. It works from supplied inputs, while optional analytics, CRM, and influencer database connectors can improve benchmarks.

faq.question: Can it estimate campaign performance?
faq.answer: It can set targets and efficiency assumptions, but forecast quality depends on reliable benchmarks, pricing, audience data, and past results.

faq.question: Does it create individual creator briefs?
faq.answer: No. It produces the campaign blueprint and hands approved requirements to a separate brief-generation workflow.

faq.question: Where are campaign details stored?
faq.answer: The skill contract specifies a campaign plan file and a shared hot cache. Review those destinations before using confidential information.
